title: Plan bare SUM/AVG direct column scan
problem: Bare SELECT SUM(column), AVG(column) FROM table materialized rows and ran generic aggregate evaluation even when only aggregate argument columns were needed.
approach: Detect one-table bare SUM/AVG column aggregate projections with no WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT, or DISTINCT aggregate modifier.
Resolve aggregate argument columns once against the table schema and allowed table/alias qualifiers.
Scan table data keys and decode only the required aggregate columns via RowDecoder::decode_column.
Accumulate SUM/AVG state directly and keep expression aggregates such as SUM(quantity * unit_price) on the generic path.
expected_impact: Improve simple full-table SUM/AVG analytics where row width is larger than aggregate column width.
risk_controls: Do not optimize queries with WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT, DISTINCT aggregates, or expression arguments.
Add SQL integration coverage proving unused columns are not decoded and alias output names are preserved.
